name: Chen Full International Co., Ltd.
summary: Chen Full International Co., Ltd., established in 1976 and based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is a global enterprise active in both engineering and manufacturing. The company provides a comprehensive suite of engineering services, including the design and installation of custom hook-up systems, cleanroom environments, strategic space planning, and advanced ultrapure water, chemical, and gas supply networks, alongside air pollution control solutions. It also acts as a primary distributor for specialized materials: SIMONA-brand engineering plastics, such as plates, rods, welding rods, and pipe fittings, and an extensive range of +GF+ branded products like semiconductor components, various pipe fittings, valves, electronic control instrumentation, and welding equipment. Additionally, Chen Full offers ACT-brand process exhaust systems. Beyond its material and engineering offerings, the company is involved in critical water treatment services, providing seawater desalination, ultrapure water generation, wastewater recycling, and potable water purification. On the manufacturing side, it produces machinery for the shoemaking industry, precision structural parts and engine casings for the aerospace sector, and essential components for optoelectronic and semiconductor equipment. Chen Full serves a diverse clientele that spans shoemaking machinery manufacturers, as well as companies in the aerospace, optoelectronic, semiconductor, and water resource industries.
